hero.intro: I'm a Full-stack Developer and Systems Analyst with experience since 2022. I build the frontend and backend of web applications, dashboards and data platforms with React, Node, Angular, React Native, Claude Code and AWS. I've worked on projects across diverse industries — custom software, industrial IoT, sports platforms and electoral software — for clients in Latin America and the US.

about.title: I build interfaces and systems that connect data with decisions.
about.description: Based in Córdoba, Argentina. I'm a full-stack developer and Systems Analyst: I work both on the frontend and the backend with React, Next.js, Node, TypeScript, Angular and SQL/NoSQL databases. I've shipped projects across diverse industries — custom software, sports platforms, electoral applications and industrial IoT platforms (airports, data centers, environmental monitoring) — for clients in Latin America and the US. I speak three languages and use AI tools (Cursor, Claude, Gemini) as an active part of my workflow.

prodeazo.description: Football prediction and statistics platform designed for the 2026 World Cup and scalable to other tournaments: real-time fixtures and results, predictions before match kick-off, points for correct picks and general and league rankings. MVP with fixture, predictions, ranking, user-to-user comparison and special picks (champion, top scorer, etc.); phased roadmap for mini-leagues with administration and a reusable statistics module (groups, brackets, metrics and profiles). Initial stack: Next.js and TypeScript, Supabase with PostgreSQL, Tailwind and NextUI; fixtures and results via Bzzoiro BSD.

scoutpanel.description: Project developed for a challenge and still in progress: I plan to keep working on it until it's complete. The frontend, backend and database design is my own. Data is fictional and loaded by seed; the app is not connected to any external statistics or real player API. Features: search and filters (position, nationality, club, age), comparison of up to three players with radar and tables, injury history linked to rating, JWT auth shortlist, clubs, exportable PDF/Excel reports, heatmaps and market view. Dark UI inspired by LDP and Sofascore. Stack: Next.js 14 (App Router), TypeScript, Tailwind, HeroUI (NextUI), Zustand and Recharts; Express API, Drizzle, Zod and PostgreSQL 16; Vitest, Supertest and Playwright tests; Docker and deploy Vercel + Render + Supabase.

appfiscalizacion.description: Web app for general electoral monitors in the October 2025 Córdoba legislative elections: dashboard, login, monitors, incidents, questions and table-by-table scrutiny, consuming a REST API. Next.js (App Router), Redux Toolkit and Tailwind; feedback with toasts and alerts. Deployed on Vercel.

queabuso.description: Two apps for the same client — Gabriel Bornoroni and Libertad Avanza Córdoba. ¡Qué Abuso! CBA: platform to report tax and bureaucratic abuses, with complaint form, evidence upload, public feed and reactions. Gabriel Bornoroni official site: campaign website with home, raffle and content sections. Full-stack: Next.js/React, TypeScript, Tailwind and Node.js + PostgreSQL.

trashcans.description: IoT dashboard for real-time monitoring of smart waste containers: fill level, temperature, alerts and collection routes. Built on the Senzary platform.

workeriq.description: Worker safety solution for ENI, built in React on top of the IoTLogIQ platform: real-time personnel tracking, geolocated maps, mustering, operational alerts and metric visualization for field teams.

iotlogiq.description: Smart Industry product built from scratch with tailored solutions for Shell, ENI, AES, IAC, Jacksonville Airport and Ternium, among others. I worked full-stack, on both frontend and backend, and supported the product migration from ThingsBoard to an in-house stack on Angular and Node.js. I also led AI tooling adoption across the development team. Over 10 projects delivered for clients in airports, oil & gas, energy, steel, data centers and environmental monitoring, mainly in Latin America and the US.

cloudlab.description: Platform for clinical laboratories aimed at streamlining the management of studies, results and patients.

iotarg.description: Full-stack IoT fleet management platform: real-time device/asset monitoring, geolocated maps, alarms, customizable drag-and-drop dashboards, and multi-client/multi-role access control. Integrates ThingsBoard as the IoT engine (telemetry, rules, entities) behind a NestJS backend exposing REST + WebSocket APIs, with a Next.js/React frontend. Built to scale across multiple clients with device hierarchies and granular role-based permissions. Currently running on ThingsBoard's free-tier plan, so some enterprise-only features are limited for now.

awsprep.description: Interactive study app for the AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam. Maps ~80 AWS services into categories and the exam's 4 domains through a zoomable mind-map, a searchable catalog, reference architecture diagrams, and a flashcard practice mode. Fully client-side, no backend. Next.js, React, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS.

fintrack.description: Full-stack app for managing income, expenses, and investments with multi-currency support (ARS/USD). Built the backend in Java 21 + Spring Boot 4 (JPA, Spring Security with JWT and Google OAuth2, Excel import via Apache POI) and the frontend in Angular 22 with Signals, integrating real-time exchange-rate and brokerage data (dólar blue, IOL) for the investments module. Includes an analytics dashboard, transaction categorization, and a consolidated net worth view.

airportiq.description: Airport operations solution built for Jacksonville Airport on top of the IoTLogIQ platform: air quality, temperature, people counting and flow, queue management and environmental monitoring. Dashboards designed for quick reading in the control room, with threshold alarms, per-terminal views and measurement history.
